about.title: Solutions, not excuses.
text: Here at Electric Diesel Solutions, we strive for perfection and excellence to ensure we deliver the best quality product and service to our customers. We understand that time is money, so we take no shortcuts in fixing your vehicle's problems. The E.D.S. team guarantees the job will be completed in a timely manner in order to get you back on the road as soon as possible.

We got caught up in the middle of both worlds, mechanical and electrical. Whether you need a fuse change or an engine swap, E.D.S. is your one stop shop, working out of over 6,000 square feet in Dayton.
Dedication is our minimum, providing results for the present, while establishing optimal resolutions for the future.

faqs.a: We specialize in datalink, engine electrical, and wiring issues. Additionally, we fabricate our own harness, assist remotely and help numerous dealerships and shops throughout Houston and its surroundings.

faqs.q: What engines do you work on?
faqs.a: We work on Detroit, CAT, Cummins, Maxx Force, DT Navistar, Mack/Volvo, Renault/Mack, Paccar.

faqs.q: Do you offer mobile repair services?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer mobile repair services for minor repairs and maintenance tasks that can be done on-site.

faqs.q: What is your warranty on repairs?
faqs.a: We offer a 90-day warranty on all repairs performed by our skilled technicians. Engine overhauls, one-year unlimited miles.
